search_results.description: The New York Post's guide highlights the top women's workout sets for 2026, focusing on performance, comfort, and style. The comprehensive review includes eight standout sets tailored to various needs. Quince's Ultra-Form set is rated best overall for its comfort, stretch, and affordability. Alo Yoga’s Airlift set excels in sculpting and style, while Fabletics impresses with inclusive sizing up to 4XL. Gymshark offers standout compression wear ideal for high-intensity workouts. Athleta caters to petite individuals with varied lengths and excellent fit, and Glowmode's FeatherFit set garners praise for flattering design and functionality. Terez is recognized for bold prints, and Carbon 38 is lauded for fashionable, leather-like activewear. The article also provides a detailed buyer’s guide emphasizing key features like material, fit, durability, and price. Each recommended set has been tested through various activities, including cardio, Pilates, and strength training, ensuring realistic insights into their performance. The guide reflects the New York Post’s commitment to honest, hands-on product evaluation and consumer transparency.
